'''Toria Tell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] inventor, [[Historian/Legends|historian]], and [[Collector/Legends|collector]] based on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Tebru]]. Her expansive home on that rocky world contained a workshop, an extensive research [[Library/Legends|library]], and a droid collection consisting of some of the oldest and rarest droids ever constructed. Her love of collecting, building, and learning about droids grew from her fascination with efficient machinery and how it interacted with its environment and organic beings, and from her trust in machinery to carry out a task without the annoying or dangerous quirks a living being might demonstrate.<ref name="SWAJ10" />

In addition to tinkering in her home, Tell also traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in her personal stock [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], exploring new droid designs, acquiring new pieces for her collection, and chronicling her findings in "[[Toria Tell's Droid Journal (scandoc)|Toria Tell's Droid Journal]]," a small, private [[Scandoc/Legends|scandoc]] distributed in a limited fashion around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One release of this scandoc during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] included information on the [[TelBrinTel Corporation|TelBrinTel]] [[Science Research Droid]], the [[Lovolan]] [[Supreme-Class Servant Droid|''Supreme''-class servant droid]], the [[Scavenger Series Labor and Recycling Droid]], the [[Ulban Arms/Legends|Ulban Arms]] [[Class I Defense Droid]], and the [[Publictechnic]] [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]] and Maintenance Droid.<ref name="SWAJ10" /> She also commented on entries for the [[S2R(A) Science Droid]] and the [[87-RM Scout Collector|87-RM Scouting Droid]] in Version 4.7.110 of [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]], under the screen name "Toria."<ref name="SWAJ13">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>

Her exploits gave her a reputation as a persistent and resourceful troublemaker, and were funded through means not immediately apparent to others. Speculation held that she had inherited a substantial fortune, or that she was actually a well-paid [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Officials within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] suspected she was a link in the growing chain of subversives and malcontents in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWAJ10" />

==Equipment==
While traveling, Tell kept with her her stock light freighter, a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[portable computer]], a [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]], and a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]].<ref name="SWAJ10" />
